mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_detail (wallet_id, user_id, type, amount, order_id, biz_round, create_time, update_time) SELECT wallet_id, user_id, #{type}, #{amount}, #{orderId}, #{bizRound}, NOW(), NOW() FROM virtual_wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.wallet_id, d.user_id, d.type, d.amount, d.order_id, d.biz_round, d.create_time FROM wallet_detail d WHERE d.type = #{platformInType} AND d.create_time <= NOW() - INTERVAL #{thresholdMinutes} MINUTE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wallet_detail u WHERE u.order_id = d.order_id AND u.biz_round = d.biz_round AND u.user_id = d.user_id AND u.type = #{platformOutType} ) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
